label: Flammability, change
description: Change in ALFRESCO relative flammability (chance of burning per year)
method: Flammability 2040–2069 (as Variant A: 5modelAvg, RCP 4.5) minus flammability 1980–2008 (the ALFRESCO historical run, MODEL-SPINUP), both from the same Rasdaman coverage alfresco_relative_flammability_30yr. Absolute change in the yearly chance of burning; not a percentage, because a third of burnable land starts at 0.
author: Joshdpaul
